routing_source_release_match.method: Release-tag commit raw factory.py downloaded once and byte-compared with installed wheel source

scope: Standalone documentation verification harness; not the upstream test suite or a live-provider evaluation
boundaries: Provider responses are deliberately scripted; no provider network/model call or provider-side enforcement was exercised.
Provider-hosted server tools and real remote background-job reconciliation are source-only boundaries.
max_concurrency=1 makes ordered receipt assertions reproducible; it is not a universal concurrency ordering promise.
Timeout is the caller's asyncio.wait_for deadline, not an agent completion condition; owned async tool cleanup was observed.
Terminal means checkpoint.next is empty, not that model prose or task quality is correct.
Failed/cancelled checkpoints can retain pending nodes; no rollback or automatic external-side-effect cancellation is promised.
